from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CreditImpairmentLoss(BaseModel):
    """One company's credit impairment loss value from a financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company this report belongs to, e.g., '山东路桥'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The line item name as written, e.g., '信用减值损失'")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The reported value as a number")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the metric and value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    credit_impairment_losses: list[CreditImpairmentLoss]
